thread:
miriam: FYI, after landing prefetch+padding on canary I see a tail regression for short-chat routes. p99 up ~300ms during peak windows.
raj: same. spike coincides with kernel switch to fast-path-v2 on thin batches.
kevin: any KV metrics? could be cache churn.
daphne: I'll try an e2e replay against the canary image. can someone post the quick perf snapshot?
miriam: pasted sampled trace from the dashboard:
```
service: inference/serve
route: chat.short
p50 22ms p95 50ms p99 328ms
chain: kernel-select -> kv-lookup -> prefix-apply -> kernel-exec
obs: prefix_kv_hit rate -2.3% during spike window
```
raj: repro steps I ran locally: 1) loadgen small-chat (median seq_len~16) 2) heuristic prefetch=on padding_range=8-48 3) kernel_affinity=auto -> p99 rises after ~3k requests
ci-bot: deploy job 7834 completed on canary
miriam: runtime profiler dump during repro shows kernel affinity flips and evictions:
```
[prof] kernel_affinity_switch at 190s
[cache] prefix_kv_evictions +12.1k
batcher.avg_batch_size 3.1 -> 2.8
latency.p99 78ms -> 410ms
```
kevin: smaller avg batch size + kernel flip = context thrash. padding likely raised prefix diversity so cache keys don't hit.
daphne: padding inflates token variety at front, TTLs/keys stop matching. maybe padding too aggressive for <32 token requests.
raj: quick mitigation plan: set kernel_affinity=legacy on canary and cap padding_max=20. rolling now.
sre-bot: rolling update: canary set kernel_affinity=legacy, padding_max=20
kevin: after mitigation p99 dropped ~200ms vs spike but still ~120ms above baseline. not fully fixed.
daphne: dug into batcher token_budget calc. it uses median seq_len; padding bumps median which lowers token_budget per-batch -> more microbatches. chain: padding -> median up -> token_budget down -> smaller batches -> kernel flip -> cache churn -> tail.
miriam: good hypothesis. suggestions: 1) change token_budget formula to use 75th percentile for short-route cohorts 2) implement soft kernel-affinity with cooldown (e.g., 60s) 3) add opt-out flag for padding when seq_len <=32
kevin: I'll author the token_budget PR + unit tests (will include bench harness).
raj: I'll canary soft-affinity with cooldown=60s and observe.
daphne: I'll run a 30m replay with traffic spikes to check throughput and tail.
miriam: add delta fields to prefix_cache_stats: evictions_since_rollout and avg_prefix_key_len so we can quickly correlate.
kevin: PR created: https://git.internal/rw/infra/+/MR-4892 (token_budget -> p75 for short routes)
daphne: replay queued, ETA ~20m. will share flamegraphs.
miriam: if token_budget tweak doesn't close the gap, we'll gate padding per-route based on throughput SLO.
raj: tagging @sre for visibility on canary metrics
sre-bot: alerts suppressed for test-canary group for 60m
miriam: closing out for now. will post dashboard snapshot when the replay completes. thanks team :thumbsup:
